title: DX Cohort Onramp: Runway, Risk Gates & Metrics Calendar
creator: Maya Gonzalez
description: Goal: Create a repeatable, data-driven onramp program for SDKs, docs, and quickstarts that reduces time-to-first-success and improves 30/90-day retention for new developer cohorts. Scope covers playbook content, experiment runway (cohort definitions, A/B variants, instrumentation), dashboards for cohort-level signals, and risk gates for gradual rollouts across self-serve and sales-assisted experiences.
updates: 2025-01-09: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Design, DX Ops. Agreed success metrics: activation rate (first successful API call), 7-day retention, time-to-first-success. Action: PM to draft hypothesis list.

2025-01-21: Draft playbook v0.1 posted to Confluence. Design provided initial templates for 3 quickstart flows (Node, Python, Postman). Follow-up: engineering to add instrumentation events for 'sample-app-run' and 'first-token-received'.
2025-02-04: Instrumentation spike completed (ENG-1842). Backend events available in staging; Grafana panel baseline created. Noted sampling variance for burst signups — added event 'onramp-source'.

2025-02-11: Design review: simplified quickstart pages to reduce cognitive load; removed optional advanced section from v0.1. Decision: ship conservative quickstarts first, then add advanced recipes as follow-ups.
2025-02-18: Experiment runway plan approved in PM sync. Three rolling cohorts defined (self-serve trial, signups from docs, and marketplace users). Owner assignments and staffing confirmed.

2025-02-24: Blocking dependency discovered: dedicated telemetry bucket for cohort tagging needs infra changes (ENG-2999). Temporary mitigation: use event property 'onramp_cohort' with manual backfill for earlier events. Next milestone: finalize A/B variants and create PRs for sample apps.
2025-02-26: Playbook v0.2 posted (addressing design feedback). Preparing announcement for beta cohort on 2025-03-10.
related_okrs: OKR-2025-Q2-DX-02: Reduce first-call-to-success time to 10 minutes
deliverables: Five quickstart samples (Node, Python, cURL, Postman, Serverless) with tests
Experiment runway schedule and hypothesis registry
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published in Confluence with owner sign-offs from Design and Eng
All quickstarts build and run in CI with smoke tests
Dashboard shows cohort-level activation, time-to-first-success, 7-day retention
Pilot cohort launched and traffic routed through experiment framework
next_steps: Finalize A/B variants and land PRs for sample apps (owners: Eng, DX Ops)
Complete infra change ENG-2999 or finalize manual backfill plan
Run alpha pilot (target: 100 users) and validate instrumentation fidelity
Prepare rollout comms and in-product banners with Growth and Product Marketing
risk_summary: Primary risks: telemetry gaps causing noisy signals; overloaded DX Ops during pilot; content mismatch for advanced users leading to lower adoption. Mitigations: conservative rollout with risk gates, manual event backfill, and a parallel lightweight support playbook for cohort owners.
